parts.title: The Dead Breach the School Gate

series.summary: On an ordinary school afternoon, Takashi skips class on the outdoor staircase while Saya mocks him for slacking. Down below, an unsettling stranger repeatedly rams his body against the locked front gate. When physical education teachers confront the intruder, he savagely bites Mr. Hayashi through the iron bars. Within seconds of dying, the teacher reanimates into a bloodthirsty monster, tearing into his colleagues right before Takashi's eyes.

segments.voiceover_text: Takashi thinks this afternoon is just another boring day to skip. He broods on the staircase while Saya mocks him. Neither realizes normal life has only minutes left.
Down at the front entrance, an eerie stranger pounds violently against the locked gate. The teachers confront him, expecting a simple trespasser.
A teacher grabs him through the bars, but the man tears into his arm. The teacher collapses, dies, and instantly reanimates to butcher his colleagues.
Watching the slaughter from above, Takashi is terrified. He turns and bolts inside before the gates give way.

parts.title: The Classroom Evacuation Turns Into Chaos

series.summary: Takashi bursts into his classroom and pulls Rei and Hisashi away, insisting that an infected killer is loose on campus. While Rei dismisses his panic as jealousy, Hisashi trusts the terror in Takashi's eyes and arms them with makeshift weapons. Their escape is interrupted when the principal's emergency evacuation broadcast abruptly turns into horrific screams as staff are devoured live over the intercom, triggering an uncontrollable stampede in the corridors.

segments.voiceover_text: Takashi kicks open the classroom door and drags Rei and Hisashi out of their seats. He desperately warns them that people are being murdered at the front gate.
Rei thinks he is overreacting, but Hisashi sees the raw terror in Takashi's eyes. He breaks a broom into an improvised spear, while Takashi grabs a wooden bat.
An emergency evacuation begins over the school intercom. Suddenly, bloodcurdling screams echo through the speakers as the staff are devoured alive.
Total pandemonium erupts. Hundreds of screaming students stampede into the hallways, straight into the jaws of the infected.

parts.title: Desperate Fight Through the Bloody Hallways

series.summary: The school corridors become a slaughterhouse as the undead swarm the fleeing student body. Takashi, Hisashi, and Rei fight their way through the upper landing, striking down attackers with their makeshift weapons. When an infected lunges at Rei, Hisashi shields her body and takes the brunt of the assault against the railing. After Takashi clubs the monster away, the three manage to barricade themselves on the rooftop, unaware of the grim toll the clash took on Hisashi.

segments.voiceover_text: The hallways have become a slaughterhouse. Trapped students are dragged down as the infection spreads through every corridor.
Takashi, Hisashi, and Rei fight through the upper stairs, striking down attackers to reach the roof.
An infected charges Rei. Hisashi throws himself in front of her, wrestling the beast against the metal railing.
Takashi crushes the attacker with his bat. They burst through the heavy fire door and barricade it shut.
Rei weeps with relief, believing they are safe. But Hisashi slumps against the wall, trembling and clutching his bleeding arm.

parts.title: A Tragic Infection Claims Their Best Friend

series.summary: From the safety of the rooftop, the three teenagers witness pillars of black smoke rising across their destroyed city. When Rei checks on Hisashi, he reluctantly rolls back his sleeve to reveal a deep human bite wound. As Rei desperately denies the truth, Hisashi's fever spikes, dark veins spiderweb across his skin, and he begins coughing blood. Knowing the transformation into an undead beast is inevitable, Hisashi begs Takashi to smash his skull before he loses control and attacks Rei.

segments.voiceover_text: Looking out across the skyline, black smoke and screaming sirens reveal a chilling truth. It is not just their school. The entire city has fallen.
Hisashi collapses against the wall. When Rei pulls back his torn sleeve, she is horrified to find a deep human bite mark.
Rei frantically denies the danger, but Hisashi knows the truth. A burning fever takes hold, and he begins vomiting blood.
With his final breath, Hisashi begs Takashi to smash his skull before he turns and hurts Rei. Moments later, his body goes limp.

parts.title: A Devastating Strike in the New World

series.summary: Moments after his death, Hisashi reanimates as a mindless zombie and lunges straight for Rei's throat. Pushing through his own heartbreak, Takashi steps in with the baseball bat and crushes Hisashi's skull to save her life. Overwhelmed by grief, Rei lashes out at Takashi in fury, accusing him of killing his best friend out of jealousy. Takashi forces her to face the brutal reality of their survival, and together on the rooftop, they vow to endure whatever horrors this new world brings.

segments.voiceover_text: Hisashi's corpse suddenly twitches. His eyes snap open, completely milky and lifeless. With a guttural snarl, he lunges straight for Rei's throat.
Rei freezes in paralyzing horror. Takashi swallows his grief, steps forward with the bat, and crushes his best friend's skull to save her life.
Overcome by shock and trauma, Rei collapses beside the body. She furiously strikes Takashi, weeping that he only killed Hisashi out of spite.
Takashi refuses to apologize for keeping her alive. Holding Rei tight against the rooftop fence, he resolves that they will survive this apocalypse together.
